name: bathroom-retile
note: The job that exposed labour/material over-splitting on 2026-08-02: one run produced 4 items, the next produced 6 by inventing an unpriced material line for the toilet and the fan.
transcript: Right, this one's for the Beridze place, it's the bathroom. I need to pull out all the old tiles first and get rid of them, then re-tile, it's about eighteen square metres, call that four hundred and fifty. Replace the existing toilet, that's ninety. And swap out the bathroom fan, forty-five.
